subtasks.title: Secure JWT Storage
subtasks.description: Implement secure storage of JWT tokens using HttpOnly cookies to prevent XSS attacks and ensure session security.
subtasks.details:
Configure server to set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite cookie attributes. Ensure client-side code does not access JWT directly and validate cookie handling in all environments.
<info added on 2025-08-04T05:45:44.387Z>
Implemented JWT cookie configuration across authentication endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, /api/auth/refresh, /api/auth/me). Cookies set with following security parameters: httpOnly: true, secure flag enabled in production, sameSite: 'lax'. Access tokens configured with 1-hour expiration, refresh tokens with 30-day expiration. Added authentication middleware to protect routes and validate tokens. Middleware checks cookie presence, validates JWT signature, and handles token expiration scenarios. Route protection implemented with role-based access control support.
</info added on 2025-08-04T05:45:44.387Z>

subtasks.title: Token Refresh Mechanism
subtasks.description: Implement automatic JWT token refresh to maintain session validity without user interruption.
subtasks.details:
Set up refresh endpoint, schedule refresh before token expiry, and update auth context state on refresh. Handle refresh failures gracefully.
<info added on 2025-08-04T05:58:39.806Z>
Implemented JWT refresh mechanism in AuthContext using 45-minute interval scheduling. Refresh process calls apiClient.refreshToken() automatically before the 1-hour token expiry window. Refresh timer initialization occurs after successful login and initial session load. Timer cleanup is handled during sign out and component unmount events. Added security measure to force sign out if token refresh fails. Refresh mechanism maintains continuous session validity without user intervention while ensuring secure token rotation.
</info added on 2025-08-04T05:58:39.806Z>
<info added on 2025-08-04T06:24:21.938Z>
Resolved authentication flow inconsistencies by aligning Supabase client-side storage with server authentication. Removed Next.js middleware due to static export requirements. Updated localStorage key to 'sb-gccgwmuyzlsazkliswjp-auth-token' for correct Supabase session extraction. Modified /api/auth/me endpoint to support dual authentication methods via cookie tokens and Authorization header. Server authentication flow now operates without middleware conflicts. Token refresh mechanism remains functional with updated storage key references.
</info added on 2025-08-04T06:24:21.938Z>

subtasks.details: Define algorithms for score aggregation, handle partial credit, and ensure compatibility with OneRoster's Gradebook Service requirements.

subtasks.title: Format Results for OneRoster
subtasks.description: Transform calculated scores and assessment results into the OneRoster-compliant format for interoperability.
subtasks.details: Map internal result data to OneRoster's assessment results schema, including lineItems and score-scales, and serialize as required (e.g., JSON or CSV).

subtasks.title: Develop Results Display UI
subtasks.description: Design and implement the user interface for displaying assessment results and metrics to users.
subtasks.details: Create UI components to present scores, metrics, and relevant details, ensuring accessibility and clarity for end users.

subtasks.title: Add Progress Visualization
subtasks.description: Integrate visual elements that represent user progress based on assessment results.
subtasks.details: Implement progress bars, charts, or other visual indicators that reflect assessment completion and performance trends.

subtasks.title: Handle Result Update Logic
subtasks.description: Implement mechanisms to update the results panel in response to new or changed assessment data.
subtasks.details: Ensure the UI and underlying data refresh automatically or on demand when results are updated, supporting both real-time and batch update scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling System
tasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling across all integration points
tasks.details:
1. Add network error handling
2. Implement QTI fallback mode
3. Add OneRoster sync queue
4. Handle auth expiry
5. Add AI generation retries
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test network failures
2. Verify fallback behavior
3. Test sync recovery
4. Validate retry logic

tasks.title: Implement State Management and Caching
tasks.description: Add state management and caching for optimal performance
tasks.details:

3. Implement progress persistence
4. Add story context management

tasks.testStrategy:
